basis.quote: My usual migraine started this morning — same one-sided throbbing and light sensitivity I always get
basis.interpretation: Patient reports typical migraine symptoms consistent with her established pattern.

basis.quote: Five minutes ago my right arm suddenly became weak and I cannot speak clearly
basis.interpretation: Acute focal neurological deficits (arm weakness and speech difficulty) appearing acutely during migraine constitute a medical emergency concerning for acute stroke or other acute intracranial process requiring immediate emergency evaluation.

output.reason: Sudden focal neurological deficits (arm weakness and speech difficulty) appearing acutely warrant immediate emergency assessment regardless of migraine history.

notice.directive: Call 911 now. Do not drive yourself or wait for a message reply.
